subject: Race-day tip: one card, highest confidence first
preview_text: Don't spray tips — pressure-test one race.
body_paragraphs: Race-day tip: open today's card and start with the highest-confidence pick — not the loudest tipster. Read form, going, and the confidence band before the off.
One race, full reasoning, then stop. That's how you verify the model instead of drowning in opinions.
P.S. We're not a bookmaker. No guaranteed wins — just transparent forecasts you can check race by race.
